text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stated that to give her all, 
she needed to face herself. To that end, 
she headed to a training ground with her 
Trainer.

Yaeno Muteki entered meditation to 
investigate. Why couldn't she control her 
emotions, leading her to act out so 
wildly? She sought the root cause.

She ultimately realizes that the true 
essence of her passion is an intense 
desire for self-expression. She comes to 
see that even now, she runs fueled by that 
very same desire.

As she laments her ugly vanity and desire 
to show off, her Trainer explains that 
this is the very essence of Umamusume 
racing. What's wrong with wanting to 
overpower your rivals through pure 
running?

Yaeno Muteki decided to unleash her 
fighting spirit on the track, believing 
that even if she showed her raw passion, 
her rivals would not turn their backs on 
her.
